help.about: Re-save pictures, sound and documents as another kind of file: pick the file, pick what it should become.

actions.label: Convert a file
actions.words: change format resize image picture sound audio document pdf

manifest.summary: Drop a file (or give a path), pick a format, get the new file in ~/Downloads/Converted. converters/ is the registry, one file each: images with Pillow, audio with ffmpeg (also the sound of a video), documents with pandoc (fetched on first use, pinned by sha256 in convert.json through shared/forge_fetch.py). Video points to MediaForge's Video Enhancer instead of re-encoding here. Each conversion is a job (shared/forge_jobs.py) that can be stopped; nothing half-written is left behind.
